title_en: Governments and experts gather in Nairobi to tackle the global housing crisis
title_zh: 各国政府和专家齐聚内罗毕解决全球住房危机

paragraphs.en: A home is a place where people can feel safe. Yet billions worldwide do not have a proper place to live. As the global housing crisis deepens, government representatives and housing experts are gathering at the United Nations in Nairobi from 26-27 November to discuss how to address it.
paragraphs.zh: 家，是让人感到安全的地方。然而，全球仍有数十亿人没有像样的栖身之所。随着全球住房危机不断加深，各国政府代表与住房专家于11月26日至27日齐聚联合国内罗毕办事处，共商应对之策。

paragraphs.en: “People don’t sleep at night because they don't know if their houses will be standing the next day,” said Anacláudia Rossbach, Executive Director of UN-Habitat , the agency working to make cities more sustainable, which is hosting the meeting.
paragraphs.zh: “人们夜里睡不着觉，因为他们不知道自己的房子第二天是否还在，”阿纳克劳迪娅·罗斯巴赫（Anacláudia Rossbach）说。她是联合国人居署（UN-Habitat）执行主任，该机构致力于推动城市更加可持续发展，也是本次会议的主办方。

paragraphs.en: This is the third session of the Open-ended Intergovernmental Expert Working Group on Adequate Housing for All (OEWG-H) which was established in 2023. It aims to advance a comprehensive set of recommendations for the UN-Habitat Assembly in 2029.
paragraphs.zh: 这是人人享有适足住房不限成员名额政府间专家工作组（OEWG-H）的第三届会议。该工作组于2023年设立，旨在为2029年联合国人居署大会提出一套全面的建议。

paragraphs.en: Speaking to UN News ahead of the meeting, Ms. Rossbach emphasized the importance of bringing the housing crisis to the attention of Member States and building consensus on how to address it.
paragraphs.zh: 会前接受联合国新闻采访时，罗斯巴赫女士强调，必须让会员国关注住房危机，并就如何应对危机凝聚共识。

paragraphs.en: Adequate housing means having the right to live somewhere in security, peace and dignity. For example, people should not fear being evicted, or that their home is unsafe because it was built with the wrong materials. She also highlighted the need to put homelessness on the global housing agenda.
paragraphs.zh: 适足住房意味着有权在安全、安宁与尊严中生活。例如，人们不应担心被驱逐，也不应担心房屋因建材不当而不安全。她还强调，必须将无家可归问题纳入全球住房议程。

paragraphs.en: However, having a home does not necessarily mean that it is safe. The latest UN-Habitat World Cities Report estimates that up to 3.4 billion people lack adequate housing, with more than 1.1 billion living in informal settlements and slums. This usually entails a lack of secure tenure, sanitation or safe water.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，有房并不一定意味着安全。联合国人居署最新的《世界城市报告》估计，多达34亿人缺乏适足住房，其中超过11亿人居住在非正规住区和贫民窟。这通常意味着缺乏有保障的住房权属、卫生设施或安全饮用水。

paragraphs.en: As governments face the challenge of improving existing housing and building new homes, they must also consider the environmental consequences of construction and where these homes are built. “Housing is the cornerstone for adaptation,” she stressed.
paragraphs.zh: 各国政府在改善现有住房和建造新住房的同时，还必须考虑建筑施工以及选址带来的环境后果。“住房是适应气候变化的关键基石，”她强调说。

paragraphs.en: To address the housing crisis, an essential component remains listening to those most affected. Ms. Rossbach underscored the importance of involving local authorities and communities in the development of housing policies, especially those in more vulnerable positions. Local governments, she explained, are closer to the communities they serve and are therefore better positioned to understand their needs.
paragraphs.zh: 要解决住房危机，一个不可或缺的环节仍然是倾听受影响最深者的声音。罗斯巴赫女士强调，让地方当局和社区、尤其是处境更为脆弱的群体参与住房政策制定十分重要。她解释说，地方政府离所服务的社区更近，因而更能了解他们的需求。

paragraphs.en: From communities and local governments to researchers and the private sector, efforts to address housing challenges are already underway. “They are finding solutions. They are innovating, and they are moving the frontier,” she said.
paragraphs.zh: 从社区和地方政府到研究机构和私营部门，应对住房挑战的努力已经在进行之中。“他们正在寻找解决方案，正在创新，正在拓展边界，”她说。
